description: Ministry of Health - Amended the Opium Board Constituted for Anuradhapura District - Amended the Opium Board Constituted Puttalam District
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns appointments to District Opium Boards under specific ordinances. The content involves the replacement of named individuals (doctors) to these boards, which are regulatory bodies related to law enforcement and the control of dangerous drugs. This falls under the Judicial/Law Enforcement category (Type 9) as it pertains to appointments within a regulatory framework for controlled substances, which is a law enforcement function. While a government minister is named as the authority making the appointments, the core content is about the specific board members and their roles within this regulatory structure, not about general government personnel or portfolio changes.
